independence_basis: The project owner repeated the wire probes; this receipt set does not claim independent assurance.

probes.probe_method: Send an incomplete request header one byte at a time at intervals shorter than the configured socket timeout, then observe handler liveness beyond that timeout.
probes.claim: A renewable socket idle timeout does not form an absolute header-completion deadline in the tested inherited parser.
probes.residual_boundary: This proves only the tested runtime behavior; it does not establish an unbounded maximum under every scheduler.

probes.probe_method: Open twelve concurrent connections with incomplete headers and compare process thread counts before capability admission.
probes.claim: The tested ThreadingHTTPServer path has no bounded worker admission before header completion.
probes.residual_boundary: The exact scheduling and thread baseline are environment-specific; the observed one-handler-thread-per-incomplete-connection relationship is the relevant result.

probes.probe_method: Send an Origin-denied request with Expect: 100-continue and record the wire status sequence.
probes.claim: Inherited Expect handling sends an interim response before application Origin denial.
probes.residual_boundary: This is an ordering and resource-consumption observation, not evidence of capability execution.

probes.probe_method: Close twelve incomplete-header client connections and inspect server stderr for framework-level BrokenPipeError tracebacks.
probes.claim: Closing incomplete-header clients can lead to response-write BrokenPipeError tracebacks in the tested inherited threaded-server path.
probes.residual_boundary: The exact count is scheduling-dependent. The stable observation is that ordinary remote disconnects can reach the framework error handler and emit full tracebacks.

raw_material.omitted_material: Raw socket transcripts, raw stderr, and local filesystem context are not included in this public projection.

residual_boundary: Bounded local-process probes. They do not prove behavior behind a real proxy, inside Docker, on other Python versions, or under sustained hostile scheduling.
